descriptions.zh:
本接口目前支持的地域为华北2（北京）、华东2（上海）、华东1（杭州），其他地域暂不支持。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
This API currently supports the China (Beijing), China (Shanghai), and China (Hangzhou) regions. Other regions are not supported at this time.

## Queries per second (QPS) limit
The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 50 requests per second per user. If you exceed this limit, your API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).
